Lean.Parser.Category.binderPred.comment:
The syntax category of binder predicates contains predicates like `> 0`, `∈ s`, etc.
(`: t` should not be a binder predicate because it would clash with the built-in syntax for ∀/∃.)
Lean.Parser.Category.binderPred.description: This definition specifies a category that includes various predicates used for binding, such as inequalities and membership conditions.
